transcript.text: My business is doing well, but I'm
completely buried. Every decision, every
fire, every small thing still runs
through me. My team escalates everything
and I can't get a single hour to
actually think. I'm exhausted and I know
I'm the bottleneck, but every time I try
to step back, something breaks. How do
you actually get out of the day-to-day
without the whole thing falling apart?
>> Okay, so right now the business lacks
cash flow in order for you to actually
hire the help you need or the the level
of talent that you need. And so there's
probably like five different potential
solutions that you have in front of you.
Number one is that the team that you
have right now is insufficient, which
either means that you don't have good
enough people, which means you could
swap or trade up in terms of the talent.
Number two is that you might need to
look at a change in your offer structure
or pricing so that you can make more
money and then with that extra cash flow
then hire additional help if you need
to. The third thing is you can look at
the core activities that you're doing
every day and see is there a place that
I could gain more leverage? Meaning, is
there a way that I could advertise more
one-to-many? Is there a way that I could
[music] do one-to-many selling? Is there
a way that I could change my delivery
agreements on the back end so that I
have less client-facing time so that I
can have some of my time back. But at
the most basic level, all we're doing is
looking at your calendar, trying to find
the times on there that we can either
replace with a better decision, which is
the leverage thing that I just said,
better talent, or more cash flow so that
we can bring new and better talent in.
